title: Right / left 11-11 (GMM)
summary: Same 11/11 recording as experiment 06 (right / left arm movements among natural ones), grouped with a Gaussian Mixture Model instead of k-means. Truth (video times + Andrew's notes) is used only to evaluate.
result: 15/19 R/L correct with k = 2 (ARI 0.30); best setting 17/19 (k = 4, threshold 70)
method: Gaussian Mixture Model (k = 2, diagonal covariance) on one feature card per detected event
